<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:e95741e53bcf3610be82c237f4e45a6e</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Enable fields to generate CSR</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    var fieldsTobeEnabledToGenerateCSR = ['organization', 'organizational_unit', 'locality', 'province', 'country', 'email', 'subject_common_name', 'subject_alternative_name'];
    var nonMandatoryFields = ['organizational_unit', 'subject_alternative_name', 'email'];
    var fieldsTobedisabledToGenerateCSR = ['csr'];

    if (newValue == "true") {
        setDisabledFields(fieldsTobeEnabledToGenerateCSR, false);
        setDisabledFields(fieldsTobedisabledToGenerateCSR, true);
        g_form.setDisplay('private_key_file', true);
        g_form.setDisplay('private_key', true);
        g_form.setDisplay('generate_csr', true);
    } else {
        setDisabledFields(fieldsTobeEnabledToGenerateCSR, true);
        setDisabledFields(fieldsTobedisabledToGenerateCSR, false);
        g_form.setDisplay('private_key_file', false);
        g_form.setDisplay('private_key', false);
        g_form.setValue('private_key_file', '');
        g_form.setValue('private_key', '');
        g_form.setDisplay('generate_csr', false);
    }

    function setDisabledFields(formFields, disabled) {
        formFields.forEach(function(item) {
            if (!nonMandatoryFields.includes(item))
                g_form.setMandatory(item, !disabled);
            g_form.setDisabled(item, disabled);
            g_form.setValue(item, '');
        });
    }

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-13 17:12:10</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>075709e53bcf3610be82c237f4e45a01</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Enable fields to generate CSR</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management" source="sn_disco_certmgmt">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_075709e53bcf3610be82c237f4e45a01</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-13 17:12:10</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
